dedupe_keys.name: tropical cyclone driven storm surge and wave database for the us coastlines

description: Mithun Deb and colleagues publish coupled ADCIRC and SWAN simulation results for major cyclones along the US North Atlantic and Gulf coasts from 1981 to 2021. Zenodo provides four decade-partitioned NetCDF files, example extraction scripts and a preview under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Node-level time series include water elevation, significant wave height, peak period, location and event identifiers. These fields can support coastal-asset exposure tests and comparison of surge-model outputs. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this multi-storm time-series release; the separate Hurricane Ian forcing experiment addresses one event and a different model. A limitation is that coverage is extraction nodes and selected storms, not a continuous shoreline forecast. The associated paper is described as submitted, so its peer-review status was not confirmed. No NetCDF was downloaded, and CF compliance, event alignment and values were not checked.
